title: Agricultural Biodiversity
claim: CBD's agricultural biodiversity programme frames crop diversity, pollinators, and soil biodiversity as central to a sustainable agriculture transition, supporting practical measures that diversify managed landscapes as a lever where species observations are low.
evidence_text: The Convention on Biological Diversity's agricultural biodiversity programme addresses the importance of agricultural biodiversity to food production and ecosystem services, covering crop diversity, pollinators, and soil biodiversity within the context of a sustainable agriculture transition. This framing supports diversifying otherwise structurally uniform managed landscapes as a practical route to increasing biodiversity where current species or pollinator observations are low.
